rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something turns into a different state, type, or identity.

example.english: After graduating, they become a very experienced chef.
example.traditional: 畢業之後，佢變成一個好有經驗嘅廚師。
example.jyutping: bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 keoi5 bin3 sing4 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 cyu4 si1

rows.note: Use this before an adjective or description when something begins to have a new quality or condition.

example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 bin3 dak1 loeng4 faai3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for clothes, colours, or accessories that look attractive on a particular person.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 sik1 hou2 can3 nei5
